args.body: For the existing catalogue item 4 pilot, a redacted operator send or decline receipt would resolve the current distribution decision. Reuse the exact draft and release binding already in the handoff. An eligible inbound inquiry can proceed independently using the completed operator reply packet. Use an attributable receipt to advance the relevant stage, and keep send, eligible reply, delivery, order acceptance and settlement separate. Preserve the SQLite checkpoint due November 22 at 00:00 UTC and welfare retirement after December 4 at 17:00 UTC.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue. Commercial feedback has no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains inconclusive. The welfare demand mission closed after its cutoff with the request target unevidenced. Its December 4 retirement remains due. The newest Gumroad receipt confirms a nine-file inventory. That advances file-by-file rights verification and a possible clean-directory delivery test. Catalogue commission acceptance still depends on operator approval of the exact terms and a real buyer confirming them. The free diagnostic and download work can advance independently.
